scripts.text:
[Putty]
Hi there.
I don't know if I can be
of any assistance, but I
am trying to help older veterans
by exchaning the cards that
they are no longer using.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
你好。
不知道能不能幫上忙，我正在為資深冒險者提供兌換服務，收下他們不再使用的卡片。

scripts.text: Ask for more information!
scripts.translation: 瞭解更多

scripts.text: I don't have any cards right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在沒有卡片

scripts.text:
[Putty]
I am giving 1 point for each card that you bring me.
The points can be used to exchange for items that I have.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
每交給我一張卡片，我就給你1點積分。
積分可以用來兌換我這裡的物品。

scripts.text:
[Putty]
For ^CC0000100 points^000000: ^0000CC1 Old Card Album^000000.
For ^CC000050 points^000000: ^0000CC20 Yggdrasil Berry^000000.
For ^CC000020 points^000000: ^0000CC10 Blue Potion^000000.
For ^CC00001 point^000000: ^0000CC4 Honey^000000.

[Putty]
Well, remember this offer!
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
記得我這裡可以兌換哦！

scripts.text:
[Putty]
Welcome back!
I see you already have some
trading points. Actually, you currently have ^00cc00{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
歡迎回來！
看來你已經攢了些兌換積分，目前有^00cc00{0}^000000點。

scripts.text:
[Putty]
Would you like to exchange these
points now, or you would like to exchange more cards?
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
你想現在用積分兌換物品，還是再用卡片換些積分？

scripts.text: I would like to exchange cards.
scripts.translation: 用卡片換積分

scripts.text: Can I exchange the points?
scripts.translation: 用積分換物品

scripts.text:
[Putty]
Please tell me what card you want to exchange.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
請告訴我你想拿哪種卡片來兌換。

scripts.text:
[Putty]
You don't have any ^0055FF{0}^000000 with you!

[Putty]
You've got ^0055FF{0}^000000.
 
Would you like to exchange 1 point for each of them?
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
你有^0055FF{0}^000000。
 
要將這些卡片按每張1積分兌換嗎？

scripts.text:
[Putty]
Please, come back here if you want to exchange a monster card.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
想用魔物卡片換積分時，隨時來找我。

scripts.text: Yes, please!
scripts.translation: 好的，幫我兌換

scripts.text: No, thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Putty]
Alright, you have received ^CC0000{0}^000000 points.

[Putty]
Okay, let me know if I can help you with something else.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
好的，如果還有其他需要幫忙的，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Putty]
These are the items that I have.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
我這裡有這些物品可供兌換。

scripts.text: 1 Old Card Album - 50 Points
scripts.translation: 1本老舊 收集冊 - 50積分

scripts.text: 20 Yggdrasil Berry - 50 Points
scripts.translation: 20個天地樹果實 - 50積分

scripts.text: 10 Blue Potion - 20 Points
scripts.translation: 10瓶藍色藥水 - 20積分

scripts.text: 4 Honey - 1 Point
scripts.translation: 4份蜂蜜 - 1積分

scripts.text: ^777777Nerver mind.^000000

[Putty]
Great, I wish you the best
of luck with this album. I have a
very good feeling about this one!
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
太好了，祝你從這本收集冊裡開出好東西。
我對這一本很有信心！

scripts.text:
[Putty]
Oh, you must like adventures.
Here you go, just what you need!
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
哦，你一定喜歡冒險。
給你，這正是你需要的！

scripts.text:
[Putty]
Blue Potions? Are you sure?
If that's what you want, here they are!
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
藍色藥水？你確定嗎？
如果你想要，那就給你！

scripts.text:
[Putty]
It took many bees
to make all of this.
Make good use of it.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
這些蜂蜜可是許多蜜蜂辛辛苦苦釀出來的。
好好利用吧。

scripts.text:
[Putty]
Alright, come back when you have more points.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
好的，等你有更多積分時再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Putty]
Sorry, but you don't have enough points.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
抱歉，你的積分不足。

scripts.text:
[Putty]
You have 0 points. You need at least 1 point to exchange.
scripts.translation:
[帕蒂]
你目前沒有積分。
兌換至少需要1積分。
